svg.title: The table doubling from 1024 buckets to 2048 as the book's 1025th different word comes, seen through one old bucket
svg.text: bin/freq data/book.txt at 01.03: FNV-1a, and twice the buckets once there are as many entries

g.title: 1024 entries in 1024 buckets, and "contralto" is the 1025th different word: table_put() calls grow() before it adds it. Old bucket 13 holds 3 entries.
g.text: each entry: its word, its index in the array, and its hash & 2047 in binary;
the first bit, bit 10, is the one the old bucket number did not use

g.title: grow(): a new bucket array of 2048, every list empty. Each entry is linked in again, in the order of the entries array, at hash & 2047.
g.text: each entry: its word, its index in the array, and its hash & 2047 in binary;
the first bit, bit 10, is the one the old bucket number did not use

g.title: Entry 335, "pacing": bit 10 of its hash is 0, so it goes to bucket 13, at the head of that list.
g.text: each entry: its word, its index in the array, and its hash & 2047 in binary;
the first bit, bit 10, is the one the old bucket number did not use

g.title: Entry 346, "habit": bit 10 of its hash is 0, so it goes to bucket 13, at the head of that list.
g.text: each entry: its word, its index in the array, and its hash & 2047 in binary;
the first bit, bit 10, is the one the old bucket number did not use

g.title: Entry 579, "pink": bit 10 of its hash is 1, so it goes to bucket 1037, at the head of that list.
g.text: each entry: its word, its index in the array, and its hash & 2047 in binary;
the first bit, bit 10, is the one the old bucket number did not use

g.title: Done: all 1024 entries linked in again (resizes 1, moves 1024); none of them was copied. Then "contralto" is added to its own bucket.
g.text: each entry: its word, its index in the array, and its hash & 2047 in binary;
the first bit, bit 10, is the one the old bucket number did not use

g.title: The whole book: the table doubled 3 times, to 8192 buckets, and moved 7168 entries in all, fewer than its 7818 words: 1.48 probes a lookup.
g.text: all 7818 different words of the book: the buckets it has had, to scale
